title: Minimum Window Substring
description:
Given strings s and t, find the shortest contiguous substring of s containing every character of t at least as many times as it occurs in t. Character matching is case-sensitive, and repeated letters in t require separate occurrences. Return the substring itself, or the empty string if no such substring exists or t is empty. The source string may also be empty.

Track how many of each required character are present while expanding a window to the right. Once all counts are satisfied, try moving the left edge right to remove unnecessary characters, recording the shortest valid span along the way. If dropping a character breaks a requirement, every earlier start is at least as long, so the left boundary can advance without backtracking.

Several shortest substrings may exist. Return the leftmost one, meaning the one with the smallest starting index; update a saved answer only for a strictly shorter span. Extra characters, including those not in t, may appear inside the result. A letter in a different case does not satisfy a requirement.

Example 1:

Input: s = "ADOBECODEBANC", t = "ABC"
Output: "BANC"

Example 2:

Input: s = "aa", t = "aa"
Output: "aa"

Example 3:

Input: s = "a", t = "aa"
Output: ""

Constraints:

  • 0 <= s.length, t.length <= 100,000
  • s and t contain printable ASCII characters
  • If t.length > s.length, no window exists.

exampleTestCases.explanation: BANC is the shortest span holding A, B, and C.
The source lacks a second a.
